Dear Mr. Fitzgerald,

Re: Account reference: ACC-356736

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have disputed the amount of the debt. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter further.

According to our records, the current balance on this account is $6,598.77. We have no record of any payments being made on this account. The original creditor of this account was Heartland Savings Bank. We are required by the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) to provide you with accurate and truthful information about this debt.

We will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the debt amount. If our investigation confirms that the debt amount is incorrect, we will take the necessary steps to correct the amount. If the debt amount is correct, we will provide you with a validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA.

Please note that the charge-off date for this account is February 2, 2021. We are a debt collector and are attempting to collect a debt on behalf of the original creditor. You have the right to dispute this debt and to request validation of the debt.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. We are committed to resolving this matter in a fair and transparent manner.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.

cc: Consumer Adjustment Co. (original creditor)

Note: This letter only addresses the dispute regarding the amount of the debt and does not address the consumer's claims regarding the account being sold to multiple account holders or the debt collection agency's reporting on the consumer's credit.
